exclusion_reason: No Win32 high-level emulation exists yet, so no guest time source can be served, and no single-clock behavior has been measured against a busy-wait or double-speed failure.
promotion_trigger: Promote when QueryPerformanceCounter, RDTSC, GetTickCount, timeGetTime, and vertical-blank all derive from one monotonic source with the one-millisecond period expectation and clamped delta.
expected_failing_assertion: The timing suite cannot keep every guest time source consistent with one monotonic clock under a busy-wait and a variable-frame workload.
active_gate_evidence: The product records the guest time-source requirement as evidence and exposes no real timestamp counter to the guest.
procedure: Drive each guest time source from a single monotonic base with a one-millisecond period and clamped delta.
Run a busy-wait, a vertical-blank spin, and a variable-frame workload and compare elapsed guest time against the reference.
pass_criterion: Every time source stays consistent with the monotonic base within tolerance.
The guest neither busy-spins at full utilization nor runs at double speed.
